    • announcement

      @NotNull public @NotNull ScenarioDescriptor.Builder announcement(@NotNull @NotNull String... lines)
      The lines this scenario suggests announcing when a match running it starts.

      Optional. Leaving it out lets the locale's shared announcement layout describe the scenario from its name and description, and a server owner can override whatever is given here in the locale file either way.

    • provides

      @NotNull public @NotNull ScenarioDescriptor.Builder provides(@NotNull @NotNull ScenarioCapability... values)
      Declares the gameplay areas this scenario takes charge of.

      Use this instead of naming every scenario that might one day get in the way: a scenario conflicting with the capability keeps clear of this one without either side knowing the other.

    • provides

      @NotNull public @NotNull ScenarioDescriptor.Builder provides(@NotNull @NotNull String... capabilityIds)
      Declares provided capabilities by identifier, for configuration-driven scenarios.

    • conflictsWithCapability

      @NotNull public @NotNull ScenarioDescriptor.Builder conflictsWithCapability(@NotNull @NotNull ScenarioCapability... values)
      Declares the gameplay areas this scenario cannot share a match with.

      Passing a capability this scenario also provides makes it mutually exclusive with every other scenario providing the same one.

    • conflictsWithCapability
